correctness.rationale: Necessity follows by applying the projection condition to u^{-1}u=1; sufficiency splits a projection product p=ab into the central corners p and 1-p, uses star-reversibility in the complementary corner, and uses a lifted corner unit B+(1-p) to force the p-corner equality.

originality.rationale: Qualified to the best of our knowledge. The 2026 source introduces pro-star-reversibility but does not discuss units or invertibility in its full HTML text. Earlier star-reversible literature supplies structural ingredients but no located statement of the exact unit-fixed characterization. Concurrent or unindexed coverage remains possible because the proof is short.

value.rationale: The criterion gives the exact extra hypothesis separating star-reversible from pro-star-reversible rings and yields complete local, clean, and division-ring classifications together with noncommutative examples.
